messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 42):
"""
Certification: The Insurer shall enclose a certificate from the Appointed Actuary, Chief Compliance Officer and Principal Officer of the Company, as per specimen given below :( The language of this should not be altered) “I, ____________________ (name of the appointed actuary), the appointed actuary, hereby solemnly declare that the information furnished above is true. Place Date: Name & Signature of the Appointed Actuary I ______________________ (Name of Chief Compliance Officer), the Chief Compliance Officer, hereby solemnly declare that the Company will ensure compliance with the extant regulatory norms governing the withdrawal of the products. Place Date: Name & Signature of the Chief Compliance Officer "This is to confirm that the information furnished above is true. The Company shall comply with extant Regulations with regard to the obligations towards all the existing Policyholders.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"Which officials are required to sign the certification for a health insurance product under the IRDAI Master Circular?","answer":"The appointed actuary, the chief compliance officer, and the principal officer of the company must sign the certification.","facts":["\"I, ____________________ (name of the appointed actuary), the appointed actuary, hereby solemnly declare\"","\"I ______________________ (Name of Chief Compliance Officer), the Chief Compliance Officer, hereby solemnly declare\"","\"This is to confirm that the information furnished above is true.\""]},{"question":"What does the certification signed by the appointed actuary and chief compliance officer confirm about the insurer’s compliance?","answer":"It confirms that the information furnished is true and that the company will ensure compliance with extant regulatory norms governing the withdrawal of the products.","facts":["\"the information furnished above is true.\"","\"the Company will ensure compliance with the extant regulatory norms governing the withdrawal of the products.\"","\"The Company shall comply with extant Regulations with regard to the obligations towards all the existing Policyholders.\""]}]}
